description: The same judgement on the second language, where the evidence is even plainer: Python needs the name declared global before an assignment reaches outside the function at all. The container write below it is the other half of the same statement -- what it was filed UNDER rather than what was filed -- and is reported by the rule that asks how large a caller can make a container become.

expected.note: the `global` declaration is what makes this a write to shared state; the route below has none and is silent
a module-level dictionary gains one entry per address anybody sends, and no comparison in this program bounds it
